instruction.text: Vervollständige das Liniendiagramm, indem du die Punkte von links nach rechts zu einem Graphen verbindest.

hint.text: Achte darauf, dass du fünf einzelne Linien ziehen musst, bevor du auf Prüfen tippst. Um die nächste Linie zu ziehen, tippe auf die jeweilige Linie unter dem Diagramm.

instruction.text: Schaue dir das Diagramm an und entscheide, ob die Aussagen darüber richtig oder falsch sind.

atoms.a: This line chart shows the average age of the US population from the year 1950 to 2020.
For every decade, there is a new figure.

hint.sound: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3'>a decade</voice> ist eine Dekade und bezeichnet einen Zeitraum von zehn Jahren

atoms.a: The average age in the given years ranges from 15 to 55 years.

atoms.b: This line chart shows the average ((++age weight)) of the people living in the USA.
From 1950 to 1970 the average age ((++decreased increased)) gradually by about two years.
After 1970, the average age ((++increased dropped)) continuously by about ten years in the following 50 years.
Excuse me, Sienna. How can a population become older?

This happens when the number of older people becomes increasingly greater than the number of ((++younger_people people_of_the_same_age)). This can be caused by ((++lower higher)) birth rates of new generations.
Normally, it is better for societies if the average age remains constant. However, this ((++growth drop)) can cause several problems.
Well, the largest problem is the ageing of the population. The outnumbered ((++younger older)) generations might not be able to care for the older generations financially and medically in the future.
